motions.item_title: Approve the Redevelopment Agency Board Meeting Minutes from December 16, 2025. Board Member Wri…
motions.motion: Board Member Clark moved to approve the Redevelopment Agency Board Meeting Minutes from December 16, 2025. Board Member Wright seconded the motion.
motions.outcome: passed by a vote of 3:0, with one abstention.
motions.headline: December 16 minutes approved
motions.summary: The agency board approved the minutes of its December 16, 2025 meeting.
motions.impact: Signing off on the written record makes December's meeting official. Nobody outside the agency's own files feels this.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Appointing and Electing Officers to Serve in the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City
motions.motion: Board Member Wood moved to elect Melissa Clark as the Vice Chairperson for the Redevelopment Agency . Board Member Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Melissa Clark elected agency vice chair
motions.summary: The agency board elected Board Member Melissa Clark as its vice chairperson.
motions.impact: Filling a presiding-officer seat is internal housekeeping for the board. It touches who runs a meeting when the chair is out, and nothing else.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Appointing Abby Ivory as Executive Director of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City Director of Legislative and Strategic Affairs Evan Berrett explained that the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain has historically appointed an Executive Director to oversee the day -to-day operations , represent the Agency to taxing entities as needed, and provide oversight and reporting to ongoing CRA project areas. Mr. Berrett noted that this role has typically been filled by the Eagle Mountain City Economic Development Director. Due to somewhat recent organizational changes, and the hiring of a new Economic Development Director for Eagle Mountain City, Abby Ivory, a new appoi ntment is recommended.
motions.motion: Board Member Wright moved to adopt a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Appointing Abby Ivory as Executive Director of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City . Board Member Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Abby Ivory named agency executive director
motions.summary: Abby Ivory, the city's new economic development director, was appointed executive director of the redevelopment agency by the agency board.
motions.impact: Ivory now runs the agency's daily work and speaks for it with other taxing entities. Staff shuffle only: your services and bills are untouched.

motions.item_title: A pprove a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Of…
motions.motion: Board Member Wright moved to a pprove a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Official Project Area Plan for the Sweetwater #4 Community Reinvestment Area Project Area . Board Member Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Sweetwater #4 project area plan amended
motions.summary: Changes to the official project area plan for the Sweetwater #4 Community Reinvestment Area won the agency board's approval.
motions.impact: A project area plan sets the boundaries and purposes of redevelopment in Sweetwater #4. What was altered is not stated in the record, so residents there cannot tell from this motion alone what is different.

motions.item_title: A pprove a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Of…
motions.motion: Board Member Wright moved to a pprove a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Official Project Area Budget for the Sweetwater #4 Community Reinvestment Area Project Area . Board Member Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Sweetwater #4 project area budget amended
motions.summary: The agency board amended the official project area budget for the Sweetwater #4 Community Reinvestment Area. No figures were stated in the motion.
motions.impact: Project area budgets govern how much property tax growth inside Sweetwater #4 the agency can spend on that area. The record here does not say what changed, so no dollar effect can be described.

motions.item_title: Ad journ the meeting at 8:43 PM. Board Member Wood seconded the motion
motions.motion: Board Member Whiting moved to ad journ the meeting at 8:43 PM. Board Member Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Meeting adjourned
motions.summary: The agency board closed its January 6 meeting at 8:43 p.m.
motions.impact: The gavel coming down is not a decision about anything. Nothing here reaches a resident.
